visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and black-rimmed glasses, wearing a light-tan The North Face t-shirt, stands in a modern kitchen. He holds a cyan bowl filled with white ice cubes. Behind him are white cabinets, a stainless steel exhaust hood, and kitchen counters with fruit. (2) He moves to a large stainless steel refrigerator and uses the ice dispenser to fill a large metal bowl with more ice cubes. His hands are visible operating the machine. (3) He is shown holding a small black digital thermometer and a small package of dark tea leaves near a silver pot on a gas stove. Close-up shots show the thermometer reading 88.7 degrees Celsius. (4) Transitioning through a stylized purple background with the word 'LATER...', he returns to the kitchen, stirring a dark liquid in the silver pot with a large ladle. He brings the ladle close to his face as if smelling it. (5) He pours the dark tea through a metal strainer into a large bowl filled with ice. Smoke or steam rises from the hot tea. (6) He holds a blue paper cup with a white logo and drinks from it. He smiles and gestures with his hands. (7) A sequence of different people tasting the tea follows: a woman with long hair on a sofa, a woman wearing a beige cap in an outdoor setting with palm trees, a shirtless man at a dining table with a child in the background, and another man with glasses in the kitchen. All hold the same blue paper cups. (8) Finally, the first man is seen in front of a digital coastal background with a blue sky and white buildings. He holds the cup, smiles broadly, and gestures as if saying goodbye.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a male voice speaking in a fast, energetic tone over an upbeat, major-mode pop track with a strong drum and synth bass beat. The environment is quiet. (2) A mechanical whirring and clattering sound of ice falling into a bowl is heard, mixed with the ongoing BGM and speech. (3) A sharp digital beep signals the use of a thermometer. The male voice maintains high arousal, punctuated by short laughing sounds. (4) Rhythmic stirring of liquid against a metal pot is audible. The music continues without interruption. (5) A distinct splashing sound of liquid being poured rapidly into a container follows, accompanied by ice cubes tinkling. (6) Multiple voices are heard in a montage: a woman laughs, another male voice offers a short praise, and various drinking sounds (gulps) are captured with high clarity. (7) The video ends with a final energetic speech from the main male voice, followed by a musical flourish that fades out with a digital stinger effect.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the 'Top Grade Tea King' from the '特好' brand by demonstrating a meticulous brewing process and showcasing positive reactions from a variety of people to validate its superior taste, especially in a foreign context like the US.
